title: Discrimination
meaning: Being treated unfairly because of who you are, such as your caste, religion, gender, disability, language, region or appearance.
examples_and_warning_signs: Being excluded or insulted because of your identity
Teachers or students making degrading remarks about a group
steps: Write down what was said or done, when and who saw it.
Raise it with the class teacher, counsellor or principal.
Ask for the school's written complaint or grievance process.
seek_immediate_help: You are threatened or physically hurt
